messages:
Zoey: Quick kickoff  we're doing a paired launch push: X single-image announcement + 4-tweet thread, LinkedIn longform next day, and a 20s demo clip. Deliverables: 2 hero images, short clip (18-22s), copy variants A/B, and HubSpot mapping for webinar regs. Need assets by Mon EOD.
Alden: I'll take the hero images and the clip edit. Which stat should go on-image? Cost reduction or throughput?
Priya: My vote is cost on-image ("~40% lower inference cost") and call out 2x throughput inside the thread. Cost reads better in the social preview.
Noah: I'll draft copy variants: A = metric-first headline, B = customer-story headline. Will keep the first line <280 chars for X and add 2 CTAs per variant.
Zoey: Awesome. Tracking: utm_campaign=launch_sep, utm_content=A|B. All webinar regs must create a HubSpot contact with property "social_series":"launch_sep" and "social_variant". Ops, can you confirm Segment->HubSpot mapping includes social_variant?
ops-bot: Reminder: include key "social_variant" in the registration payload. I'll create a test workflow once assets are uploaded.
Alden: Uploaded draft assets: https://files.redwood/launch/hero_metric_v1.png and https://files.redwood/launch/demo20_v1.mp4. Filenames will include variant suffix when finalized.
Priya: Reviewed clip suggest trimming 0.8s at start, add 1.5s end-frame CTA with shortlink go.red/launchsep, reduce music volume and add caption overlay for accessibility.
Noah: Draft copy A/B posted: https://docs.redwood/launch-copy-A and https://docs.redwood/launch-copy-B. Both include UTM placeholders. Variant A leads with metric, B starts with a short customer anecdote.
Zoey: Schedule proposal: X announcement Tue 9:15am PT, follow-up thread 2h later with demo clip + behind-the-scenes tweet, LinkedIn longform Wed 10am PT. Buffer scheduling OK?
Alden: Works for me. I'll export final hero images at 1920x1080 and label them heroA.png / heroB.png. Also compress clip to <12MB for X.
ops-bot: Test HubSpot workflow created (wf_launch_sep). Test contact routed to #sales-inbound: tag=launch_sep, social_variant=A, owner=SDR-rotation. Webhook confirmed.
Zoey: Inbound routing: registrants -> nurture list; attendees -> SDR hot leads + immediate notify #sales-inbound. Add "urgent" flag if company_size>500 or industry contains "security" or "finance". Ops please implement.
Noah: For measurement, we'll track CTR, reg conversion, demo requests, and MQL rate by variant. Can analytics create a dashboard widget for that?
Priya: I'll prep 3 canned reply templates for CMs (thanks, question, demo offer) and a 48h outreach sequence for commenters -> SDR nurture. Posting them in the doc in 30m.
Alden: Uploaded revised clip: https://files.redwood/launch/demo20_v2.mp4  trimmed, end-frame CTA added, captions included, compressed for X.
Noah: Small copy request: shorten Variant A's first paragraph to ~220 chars so preview looks good on X. Also please ensure LinkedIn longform includes 1-2 short product quotes from eng/product.
Zoey: Pinged product for 2 concise quotes (customer-tone preferred). ETA 4 hours.
ops-bot: Reminder: include mapping key 'social_variant' in the form's hidden fields. Automation checklist created.
Alden: Final assets uploaded and metadata added (variant, creator, final/placeholder): https://files.redwood/launch/final-pack.zip. Filenames include variant suffixes.
Noah: I've created the draft Buffer posts and tagged Zoey for final approval. Also added UTM-ified shortlinks: go.red/launchsep?utm_content=A etc.
cm-bot: Reminder to community managers: reply templates available in the doc. Suggested cadence: respond within 4 hours to comments, escalate demo-requests to #sales-inbound.
Zoey: Great work. Final QA checklist before scheduling: alt text for images, UTMs on all links, HubSpot workflow test pass, Buffer drafts queued. Please tag me when ready for final approve. Thanks team :rocket:
Noah: Tagged you in Buffer. Will hold posting until you approve tomorrow morning.
Alden: Thanks, will stand by for final thumbs up and then we schedule. :thumbsup:
